text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq and Tunisia start talks on trade and agriculture in Tunis.
- Lebanese industrialists are disappointed at Lebanon's decision to exclude Iraq from the Pan Arab Games last month.
(The above items were also carried by IRAQ)
- Editorial marking the seventh anniversary of Iraq's invasion of Kuwait on August 2, 1990.
- Iraq marks today the anniversary of killing of Iraqi prisoners of war by Iran during the 1980-88 Iraq-Iran war.
